title: Design System: Typst-Editor by Kong (landing page)

display.purpose: Foil title on the front board; small-caps bold.

body.purpose: Running text on paper, 68ch, indented paragraphs.

label.purpose: All-small-caps running heads, cover points, spine title.

label-sans.purpose: Spine label and comment-demo controls only.

mono.purpose: Inline code, keys and command blocks.

shadows.name: page-drop
shadows.purpose: Spreads and plates on cloth; always with a 1px paper-edge bottom border.

shadows.name: sticky-note
shadows.purpose: Comment notes beside the demo text.

shadows.name: cloth-fold
shadows.purpose: Inner top edge of the case; the back cover uses inset 0 14px 22px -14px rgba(0,0,0,0.75).

shadows.name: blind-stamp
shadows.purpose: The foil frame's pressed double rule on the front board.

shadows.name: spine-round
shadows.purpose: Spine edge against the board; paired with a horizontal shading gradient.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: All state transitions: label lift (160ms), sticky-note repositioning (220ms).

motion.name: board-open
motion.value: scroll-linked rotateY(0 to -72deg) with brightness(0.55), over 0 to 80vh of root scroll, transform-origin left center
motion.purpose: The front board swings open on its spine as the cover scrolls away. Only with animation-timeline support, above 720px, and without reduced motion.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: No board swing; scroll-behavior auto instead of smooth.

narrative.overview:
The site is one book handled once. It arrives closed: a green buckram case with woven grain, gold-foil lettering on the front board, a spine carrying gilt double rules and a pasted white library label that is the download button. Scrolling past the cover swings the board open on its spine, and everything below is the book's interior: bright white pages set in Libertinus Serif with the apparatus of a typeset thesis (title page, dot-leader contents, running heads, folios, numbered chapters, figures and tables, footnotes, references, colophon).

Density is that of a printed page, not a marketing layout. Pages sit in two-column spreads on the cloth, with a gutter shadow where they curve into the binding; one figure is a full-width fold-out plate. Persuasion comes from the typesetting itself being the proof: the page reads the way a Typst thesis would. Colour outside the cloth, foil and ink belongs to the product's comment feature, and only appears where that feature is demonstrated.
keyCharacteristics: Two materials only: cloth (with foil) outside, paper (with ink) inside.
Flat gold foil, no emboss, no gradient lettering.
Book apparatus does the navigation: contents page, running heads, folios, numbered references.
Physical depth from soft paper shadows and inset cloth shading; never hard offsets.
One signature motion: the front board opens on its spine with scroll.

rules.name: The Two Materials Rule
rules.body: Cloth carries foil; paper carries ink. Foil never appears on paper and paper-toned text never appears on cloth except the spine label, which is itself a piece of paper pasted on.

rules.name: The Highlighter Rule
rules.body: The four highlighter pigments appear only where the comment feature is: its swatches, its marks and its sticky notes. They are not accents, not status colours and not decoration.

rules.name: The Real Small Caps Rule
rules.body: Labels are set with `font-variant-caps` (small caps or all small caps) plus modest tracking, never with uppercase text-transform; the face has true small caps and the thesis voice depends on them.

rules.name: The Thesis Numbering Rule
rules.body: Chapters, sections, figures, tables, footnotes and references are numbered and cross-referenced exactly as a typeset thesis would number them. Every number shown is real and links to its target.

rules.name: The Soft Paper Rule
rules.body: Shadows are soft and blurred, cast by paper on cloth or by a pasted object on paper. A paper object always pairs its shadow with a 1px paper-edge border.

rules.name: The Flat Foil Rule
rules.body: Foil lettering is a flat colour with no text-shadow, emboss, glow or gradient. Depth on the cover comes from the cloth and the stamped frame, not from the letters.

dos: **Do** set every word on cloth in flat foil (#d8b765), in small caps or the small-caps bold title style.
**Do** put new content on paper: a page in a spread, or a full-width plate, with the page-drop shadow and the 1px paper-edge border.
**Do** give pages the thesis apparatus: running head (except on chapter openers), folio, numbered headings, numbered and captioned figures and tables.
**Do** keep the download action as the pasted spine label wherever it appears.
**Do** honour reduced motion: the board does not swing and scrolling is not smooth.
**Do** write body text at 68ch or less, hyphenated, with indented paragraphs and no paragraph gaps.
donts: **Don't** add text-shadow, emboss, glow or gradient to foil lettering.
**Don't** use hard, unblurred offset shadows anywhere.
**Don't** use the highlighter pigments outside the comment feature.
**Don't** introduce a second display face or set labels in uppercase; use Libertinus small caps.
**Don't** round the book's own surfaces (cloth, pages, plates, tables, code blocks).
**Don't** add a running head to a chapter-opening page.
**Don't** apply anything in this file to the desktop app in `src/`.
